name: router_profile_check
description: Probe router gateway to detect hardware model, firmware build string, and auth encryption type (AES, RSA, MD5, or plain form).
example_prompt: Probe the router at 192.168.1.1 and report the model and auth type.

name: router_get_status
description: Retrieve comprehensive runtime telemetry: WAN IP, gateway, DNS servers, uptime, cellular network type, and connection state.
example_prompt: Check whether the router is online and retrieve the current WAN IP and primary DNS.

name: router_get_rf_signal
description: Read cellular radio frequency telemetry: RSRP (dBm), RSRQ (dB), SINR (dB), RSSI, current LTE/5G band, and Physical Cell ID (PCI).
example_prompt: What is our current 4G signal quality, RSRP, and SINR in dB?

name: router_lock_cell_band
description: Force-lock modem to specific LTE carrier band (e.g., Band 3 1800MHz, Band 8 900MHz, Band 40 2300MHz) or Physical Cell ID (PCI).

parameters.name: band
parameters.description: LTE band to lock, e.g. '3', '8', '20', '40', or 'AUTO'.

parameters.name: pci
parameters.description: Optional Physical Cell ID (PCI) to lock to a specific tower antenna.

example_prompt: Lock the router modem to LTE Band 3 (1800MHz) to escape the congested Band 8 tower.

name: router_set_network_mode
description: Switch cellular RAT between AUTO, 4G_ONLY, 3G_ONLY, and 5G_NSA to prevent drops to degraded 3G fallbacks.
example_prompt: Set the cellular network mode to 4G_ONLY to prevent the connection from downgrading.

name: router_manage_apn
description: Read or update the cellular APN profile, PDP type (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6), and authentication credentials.
example_prompt: Configure the APN to 'hutch3g' with PDP type IPv4.

name: router_read_sms
description: List SMS messages stored on the SIM card, read sender phone numbers, timestamps, message content, and extract 2FA codes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of recent messages to return (default: 10).

example_prompt: Read the latest 5 incoming SMS messages to check for carrier reload verification codes.

name: router_send_sms
description: Transmit an outgoing SMS message via the SIM modem to activate package bundles, query quotas, or send alerts.

parameters.name: phone_number
parameters.description: Recipient phone number or carrier shortcode (e.g. '344').

example_prompt: Send an SMS to '344' with body 'MYPLAN' to check carrier bundle status.

name: router_send_ussd
description: Send interactive USSD code to the mobile network operator gateway and capture the returned response text.
example_prompt: Execute USSD code '*344#' and return the balance text.

name: router_get_wifi_status
description: Inspect 2.4GHz & 5GHz Wi-Fi interfaces: SSID, enable state, channel, channel width (20/40/80 MHz), and security cipher.
example_prompt: What Wi-Fi channels and channel widths are currently configured?

name: router_set_wifi_channel
description: Change Wi-Fi broadcast channel to avoid apartment or neighborhood frequency interference.
example_prompt: Switch the 2.4GHz Wi-Fi channel to channel 6 to reduce interference.

name: router_get_connected_devices
description: List all active DHCP and Wi-Fi clients with hostnames, IP addresses, MAC addresses, and connection interface.
example_prompt: Show all devices connected to the router right now with their MAC and IP addresses.

name: router_reboot
description: Initiate a clean software reboot of the router OS and cellular modem module.
example_prompt: Restart the router to clear memory and reinitialize the radio.

name: router_reconnect_wan
description: Tear down and re-establish the cellular PPP/QMI/NDIS WAN connection to obtain a fresh CGNAT IP lease without rebooting.
example_prompt: Reconnect the cellular session to obtain a new carrier IP address.

name: router_ping_pulse
description: Send low-overhead 28-byte UDP/ICMP echo pulses to remote server to prevent carrier NAT timeout and radio state demotion.
example_prompt: Start a 25-second keepalive pulse to 1.1.1.1 to keep the LTE radio in active RRC state.

name: router_benchmark_network
description: Measure baseline latency, loaded bufferbloat jitter, and MTU path packet fragmentation.
example_prompt: Run a bufferbloat and MTU fragmentation benchmark against 1.1.1.1.

name: router_optimize_network
description: Apply or revert kernel BBR congestion control, 1420 MTU GTP clamping, and 1.1.1.1 DNS tuning.
example_prompt: Apply cellular optimization rules: BBR TCP congestion control and 1420 MTU clamp.

name: router_execute_command
description: Execute arbitrary raw JSON-RPC or cgi-bin command directly against the router administrative interface.
example_prompt: Send a direct diagnostic request to the router status endpoint.
